1#include "COINAlgebra/Core/DecayLevel.h"
2#include "COINAlgebra/Core/DecayTransition.h"
3#include "COINAlgebra/Core/DecayPath.h"

6#include <cassert>
7#include <cmath>
8#include <iostream>

11
12void test_vector()
13{
14    std::cout << "========================================\n";
15    std::cout << "      COINAlgebra DecayVector Tests\n";
16    std::cout << "========================================\n\n";
17
18
19    // ========================================================
20    // Levels
21    // ========================================================
22
23    DecayLevel d0("d0");
24    DecayLevel d1("d1");
25    DecayLevel d2("d2");
26
27
28    // ========================================================
29    // Transitions
30    // ========================================================
31
32    DecayTransition gamma1(
33        "gamma1",
34        &d0,
35        &d1,
36        0.4
37    );
38
39    DecayTransition gamma2(
40        "gamma2",
41        &d1,
42        &d2,
43        0.6
44    );
45
46
47    // ========================================================
48    // Paths
49    // ========================================================
50
51    DecayPath e0(&d0);
52    DecayPath e1(&d1);
53
54    DecayPath p1(gamma1);
55
56    DecayPath p2(
57        std::vector<DecayTransition>{
58            gamma1,
59            gamma2
60        }
61    );
62
63
64    // ========================================================
65    // Test 1: Empty vector
66    // ========================================================
67
68    std::cout << "Test 1: Empty vector...\n";
69
70    DecayVector empty;
71
72    assert(empty.Empty());
73    assert(empty.Size() == 0);
74    assert(empty.GetTerms().empty());
75
76    std::cout << "  PASS\n\n";
77
78
79    // ========================================================
80    // Test 2: Vector containing a stationary path
81    // ========================================================
82
83    std::cout
84        << "Test 2: Stationary path component...\n";
85
86    DecayVector stationary(
87        e0,
88        0.7
89    );
90
91    assert(!stationary.Empty());
92    assert(stationary.Size() == 1);
93
94    const auto& stationary_term =
95        stationary.GetTerms()[0];
96
97    assert(stationary_term.path.IsStationary());
98
99    assert(
100        stationary_term.path.GetSource() == &d0
101    );
102
103    assert(
104        stationary_term.path.GetTarget() == &d0
105    );
106
107    assert(
108        stationary_term.path.Length() == 0
109    );
110
111    // Intrinsic probability of stationary path.
112    assert(
113        std::abs(
114            stationary_term.path.GetProbability() - 1.0
115        ) < 1.0e-12
116    );
117
118    // Coefficient of stationary path in vector.
119    assert(
120        std::abs(
121            stationary_term.coefficient - 0.7
122        ) < 1.0e-12
123    );
124
125    std::cout
126        << "  Path probability: "
127        << stationary_term.path.GetProbability()
128        << "\n";
129
130    std::cout
131        << "  Vector coefficient: "
132        << stationary_term.coefficient
133        << "\n";
134
135    std::cout << "  PASS\n\n";
136
137
138    // ========================================================
139    // Test 3: Ordinary path probability
140    // ========================================================
141
142    std::cout
143        << "Test 3: Ordinary path probability...\n";
144
145    assert(
146        std::abs(
147            p2.GetProbability() - 0.24
148        ) < 1.0e-12
149    );
150
151    std::cout
152        << "  Path: "
153        << p2.ToString()
154        << "\n";
155
156    std::cout
157        << "  Path probability: "
158        << p2.GetProbability()
159        << "\n";
160
161    std::cout << "  PASS\n\n";
162
163
164    // ========================================================
165    // Test 4: Explicit probability coefficient
166    // ========================================================
167
168    std::cout
169        << "Test 4: Path coefficient equal to probability...\n";
170
171    DecayVector probability_vector(
172        p2,
173        p2.GetProbability()
174    );
175
176    assert(probability_vector.Size() == 1);
177
178    const auto& probability_term =
179        probability_vector.GetTerms()[0];
180
181    assert(
182        std::abs(
183            probability_term.coefficient -
184            p2.GetProbability()
185        ) < 1.0e-12
186    );
187
188    assert(
189        std::abs(
190            probability_term.coefficient - 0.24
191        ) < 1.0e-12
192    );
193
194    std::cout
195        << "  Path probability: "
196        << probability_term.path.GetProbability()
197        << "\n";
198
199    std::cout
200        << "  Vector coefficient: "
201        << probability_term.coefficient
202        << "\n";
203
204    std::cout << "  PASS\n\n";
205
206
207    // ========================================================
208    // Test 5: Default coefficient is 1
209    // ========================================================
210
211    std::cout
212        << "Test 5: Default coefficient...\n";
213
214    DecayVector default_coefficient(
215        p1
216    );
217
218    assert(default_coefficient.Size() == 1);
219
220    const auto& default_term =
221        default_coefficient.GetTerms()[0];
222
223    assert(
224        std::abs(
225            default_term.coefficient - 1.0
226        ) < 1.0e-12
227    );
228
229    // The path probability is different from the
230    // vector coefficient in this case.
231    assert(
232        std::abs(
233            default_term.path.GetProbability() - 0.4
234        ) < 1.0e-12
235    );
236
237    assert(
238        std::abs(
239            default_term.coefficient -
240            default_term.path.GetProbability()
241        ) > 1.0e-12
242    );
243
244    std::cout
245        << "  Path probability: "
246        << default_term.path.GetProbability()
247        << "\n";
248
249    std::cout
250        << "  Vector coefficient: "
251        << default_term.coefficient
252        << "\n";
253
254    std::cout << "  PASS\n\n";
255
256
257    // ========================================================
258    // Test 6: Multiple terms
259    // ========================================================
260
261    std::cout
262        << "Test 6: Multiple vector components...\n";
263
264    DecayVector v;
265
266    v.AddTerm(
267        e0,
268        0.7
269    );
270
271    v.AddTerm(
272        p1,
273        0.2
274    );
275
276    v.AddTerm(
277        p2,
278        0.1
279    );
280
281    assert(v.Size() == 3);
282
283    const auto& terms =
284        v.GetTerms();
285
286    assert(terms[0].path == e0);
287    assert(terms[1].path == p1);
288    assert(terms[2].path == p2);
289
290    assert(
291        std::abs(terms[0].coefficient - 0.7)
292        < 1.0e-12
293    );
294
295    assert(
296        std::abs(terms[1].coefficient - 0.2)
297        < 1.0e-12
298    );
299
300    assert(
301        std::abs(terms[2].coefficient - 0.1)
302        < 1.0e-12
303    );
304
305    std::cout
306        << "  Vector: "
307        << v.ToString()
308        << "\n";
309
310    std::cout << "  PASS\n\n";
311
312
313    // ========================================================
314    // Test 7: Multiple stationary paths
315    // ========================================================
316
317    std::cout
318        << "Test 7: Multiple stationary paths...\n";
319
320    DecayVector stationary_vector;
321
322    stationary_vector.AddTerm(
323        e0,
324        0.7
325    );
326
327    stationary_vector.AddTerm(
328        e1,
329        0.3
330    );
331
332    assert(stationary_vector.Size() == 2);
333
334    const auto& stationary_terms =
335        stationary_vector.GetTerms();
336
337    assert(
338        stationary_terms[0].path.IsStationary()
339    );
340
341    assert(
342        stationary_terms[1].path.IsStationary()
343    );
344
345    assert(
346        stationary_terms[0].path.GetSource() == &d0
347    );
348
349    assert(
350        stationary_terms[1].path.GetSource() == &d1
351    );
352
353    assert(
354        std::abs(
355            stationary_terms[0].coefficient - 0.7
356        ) < 1.0e-12
357    );
358
359    assert(
360        std::abs(
361            stationary_terms[1].coefficient - 0.3
362        ) < 1.0e-12
363    );
364
365    std::cout
366        << "  Vector: "
367        << stationary_vector.ToString()
368        << "\n";
369
370    std::cout << "  PASS\n\n";
371
372
373    // ========================================================
374    // Test 8: Addition
375    // ========================================================
376
377    std::cout
378        << "Test 8: Vector addition...\n";
379
380    DecayVector a(
381        e0,
382        0.4
383    );
384
385    DecayVector b(
386        e1,
387        0.6
388    );
389
390    DecayVector sum = a + b;
391
392    assert(sum.Size() == 2);
393
394    std::cout
395        << "  Sum: "
396        << sum.ToString()
397        << "\n";
398
399    std::cout << "  PASS\n\n";
400
401
402    // ========================================================
403    // Test 9: Simplification of identical stationary paths
404    // ========================================================
405
406    std::cout
407        << "Test 9: Stationary-path simplification...\n";
408
409    DecayVector simplified;
410
411    simplified.AddTerm(
412        e0,
413        0.2
414    );
415
416    simplified.AddTerm(
417        e0,
418        0.3
419    );
420
421    assert(simplified.Size() == 1);
422
423    const auto& simplified_term =
424        simplified.GetTerms()[0];
425
426    assert(
427        simplified_term.path == e0
428    );
429
430    assert(
431        std::abs(
432            simplified_term.coefficient - 0.5
433        ) < 1.0e-12
434    );
435
436    std::cout
437        << "  Simplified vector: "
438        << simplified.ToString()
439        << "\n";
440
441    std::cout << "  PASS\n\n";
442
443
444    // ========================================================
445    // Test 10: Different stationary paths are not equal
446    // ========================================================
447
448    std::cout
449        << "Test 10: Distinct stationary paths...\n";
450
451    assert(e0 != e1);
452    assert(!e0.HasSameEndpoints(e1));
453
454    std::cout << "  PASS\n\n";
455
456
457    // ========================================================
458    // Test 11: Scalar multiplication
459    // ========================================================
460
461    std::cout
462        << "Test 11: Scalar multiplication...\n";
463
464    DecayVector scaled =
465        stationary * 2.0;
466
467    assert(scaled.Size() == 1);
468
469    assert(
470        std::abs(
471            scaled.GetTerms()[0].coefficient - 1.4
472        ) < 1.0e-12
473    );
474
475    // The path probability remains unchanged.
476    assert(
477        std::abs(
478            scaled.GetTerms()[0].path.GetProbability()
479            - 1.0
480        ) < 1.0e-12
481    );
482
483    std::cout
484        << "  Scaled vector: "
485        << scaled.ToString()
486        << "\n";
487
488    std::cout << "  PASS\n\n";
489
490
491    // ========================================================
492    // Test 12: Vector subtraction
493    // ========================================================
494
495    std::cout
496        << "Test 12: Vector subtraction...\n";
497
498    DecayVector c(
499        e0,

501    );
502
503    DecayVector d(
504        e0,
505        0.2
506    );
507
508    DecayVector difference =

510
511    assert(difference.Size() == 1);
512
513    assert(
514        std::abs(

518

523
524    std::cout << "  PASS\n\n";
525

527    // ========================================================

531    std::cout << "========================================\n";
